title: 노른자 터짐 방지 대작전

cuts.scene: Kitchen counter. The wife rabbit is holding a broken egg, looking frustrated. Yolky mess on the counter. The husband sloth is leaning against a fridge, observing lazily.
Close up on the husband sloth, a small, dry smile playing on his lips. He slowly sips coffee.
The wife rabbit spots a small, peculiar device on the counter next to a pile of unopened mail. She picks it up curiously.
The wife rabbit uses the real product to separate an egg. White drips perfectly into a bowl. Her eyes widen in surprise.
The husband sloth watches the wife, a faint smirk. He slowly sets down his coffee cup.
The guide character (a small, dapper bird) pops into frame. A product card with 'the real product' appears next to it. A large '글쎄' stamp thuds onto the card.
The wife rabbit looks around, her eyes darting towards a nearby kitchen drawer. Her expression is one of dawning realization.
The husband sloth is back at the fridge, still leaning, arm casually blocking the drawer. The wife rabbit looks defeated but pauses.

situation: 아침 계란 요리 중 노른자 터짐
